title: Self-Cross Diffusion Guidance for Text-to-Image Synthesis of Similar Subjects
role: A box-free, training-free latent guidance that places subject mixing in the overlap of one subject's self-attention region with the other's cross-attention map; a candidate fourth predictor and a box-free alternative fix.
enters: a combination: self-attention (a subject's patches attending to the other subject's region) measured against cross-attention
enters_evidence: Argument plus qualitative figures: Fig. 2 shows one bear-and-elephant seed where cross map of one subject overlaps the aggregated self map of the other; Fig. 7 shows mixing persists with 1 or 16 patches on 3 prompts. No number ties overlap size to mixing.
changes: Gradient steps on the latent against g(i,j) = sum min(A^s_i, A^c_j) + sum min(A^c_i, A^s_j) plus Attend-and-Excite's existence term, over the first 25 of 50 steps, refinement at steps 10 and 20, plus INITNO starting-noise search
training: Nothing trained; needs the subject token indices in the prompt; no boxes, masks or LLM
model: SD1.4, SD2.1, SD3-medium (PNDM, CFG, 50 steps, native resolution); SDXL not tested
similar_subjects: SD1.4 GPT-4o not-a-mixture rate (0-100, higher better): SSD-2 similar pairs 86.45 vs 79.70 INITNO vs 77.47 plain; Animal-Animal 92.94 vs 84.22 CONFORM. SD2.1 alone loses to CONFORM (78.79 vs 92.49 Animal-Animal); SD3 SSD-3 77.15 vs 70.08
which_pairs: Not measured per pair; argued that similar-looking subjects with shared structure and different details (leopard and tiger) mix more, and that mixing survives in hair, teeth and feet when only the peak patch is guided
when: Not measured; guidance limited to the first half (25 of 50 steps) because early attention maps are 'known to be semantically meaningful'
cost: No timings printed; at least one backward pass per step over the first 25 of 50 steps, plus refinement iterations and the INITNO noise search (inferred from Algorithm 1)
headline: SD1.4 Animal-Animal: 92.94% of images judged not a mixture by GPT-4o vs 84.22% for CONFORM and 72.24% for plain SD1.4 (65 seeds x 66 prompts)
suggests: (inferred) Add g(i,j) as a fourth per-pair predictor beside cross-attention overlap at CO3's corrected steps, using the whole thresholded region; keep Self-Cross as a box-free fix if Bounded Attention's boxes are the obstacle, expecting one backward pass per guided step.

disagreements.paper_says: Text on p. 8 gives INITNO's SSD score as 70.70% and calls the set SSD-1; Table 4 (p. 7) gives INITNO 79.70 on SSD-2, and the stated 6.7-point gap matches 79.70

disagreements.claim: SSD causes more mixing than the original sets for each method
disagreements.paper_says: p. 5 says each method mixes more on SSD, but plain SD1.4 scores 77.47 not-a-mixture on SSD-2 against 72.24 on Animal-Animal (Table 4, p. 7), partly because plain SD1.4 often drops a subject (Ext 30.77)

disagreements.claim: Method boosts any UNet or transformer model
disagreements.paper_says: p. 1 claims it boosts any model, but on SD2.1 Self-Cross alone scores 77.08 not-a-mixture on SSD-2 against 84.932 for plain SD2.1 and 89.76 for CONFORM (Table 5, p. 7); only CONFORM followed by Self-Cross wins

disagreements.claim: Text-text similarity is state of the art on all benchmarks
disagreements.paper_says: p. 8 claims this, but Table 3 (p. 6) has CONFORM at 85.21 above Self-Cross at 84.02 on SD2.1 Animal-Animal; only the combination is best
